verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud's Adaptive Telemetry is a first-party feature for managing telemetry volume and cost: it automatically identifies the data worth keeping and aggregates the rest. That is related to the story, but the evidence describes automatic aggregation, not developer-controlled trace/log sampling rules or retention tiers. missing for 10: explicit configurable trace sampling, log sampling controls, retention tier/period configuration, documentation of how developers deliberately tune these, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can control trace/log sampling and retention tiers to manage data volume deliberately

citations.quote: Grafana Cloud’s Adaptive Telemetry suite automatically identifies the data worth your attention and aggregates the rest, cutting your telemetry costs by up to 80%.
Simplify cost management with Adaptive Telemetry
